rules: Music ducks −9 dB under speech (attack 0.15 s, release 0.5 s).
SFX sit below speech; no whoosh on ordinary moves; no booms on buttons.
Silence is used on purpose: before NavisLabs, on Approve, under the refusal, at the end.
No clipping: true peak ≤ −1 dBTP on the mix.

content.style: One continuous score: a low bed, a subtle pulse, precise developer rhythm, warmer human texture, a merged motif, quiet resolution, silence. No stock-corporate, no trailer drums, no 'AI' arpeggios, nothing that competes with a male voice (leave 120–350 Hz and 2–4 kHz open under speech).

lines_detail.voice_line: Your company already has the answer.
It's scattered across the systems where work happens.
People rebuild it by hand. Agents start without it.
NavisLabs turns those signals into one shared understanding.
Every email, meeting, document and message becomes a signal —
remembered, connected, and turned into what should happen next.
Inside an organization, Navis Application is for people.
It shows what changed — Acme's renewal moved.
And why: every fact with its source, its time, and how fresh it is.
It's waiting on you, so Navis drafts the reply.
A person decides.
Then the company acts.
The same organization's agents use Navis Developer.
Invite the team. Connect once — MCP, API, SDK or CLI.
The agent asks — and gets cited facts, with their freshness.
Navis isn't the model. It supplies the company's truth.
Every request is checked against its permissions.
The agent does the work, and the run is on record.
A solo builder gets a private workspace — and the work state carries into the next session.
One organization. The person and the agent acted on the same event.
Same facts. Same sources. Same freshness.
One understanding. Two ways in.
Models change. Agents change. Tools change.
Your company keeps its history.
Company-owned. Model-neutral. Shared by people and agents.
NavisLabs. The shared understanding for your organization.

creative_test.muted: The UI carries the story without narration: one customer event, its evidence, a human approval and a sent reply; then the same facts reaching an agent with source and freshness.
creative_test.audio_only: The VO script states the problem, the shared understanding, both products and the ending line; the temp voice is a placeholder.
creative_test.serious_company: Real product strings and flows from the source, real commands with placeholders, no invented metrics; future systems labelled.
